title: Search quality rating tools: how to manage your Mac workflow and tasks
metaTitle: Search quality rating tools: Mac workflow guide for evaluators
description: Improve your efficiency as a search engine evaluator on Mac. Use Lazur to manage your rating tasks, documentation, and administrative work effectively.
intro: Search quality rating tools are the core of your daily work as an evaluator. Managing these web-based portals alongside your administrative tasks requires a clear system on your Mac.
tldr: Search quality rating tools are primarily browser-based platforms.
Efficiency depends on your ability to switch between rating tasks and documentation.
Use Lazur to quickly reference guidelines and draft rationales.
Independent contract work requires strict management of your active time.
Mac shortcuts and voice assistance can reduce the physical strain of repetitive tasks.

blocks.text: Most search quality rating tools run entirely in Google Chrome or Safari. Your browser is your primary workspace. You likely have multiple tabs open for guidelines, the rating portal, and communication channels. Use ⌘ 1 through ⌘ 8 to jump between these tabs. If you find yourself losing track, consider using tab groups. Right-click a tab and select Add Tab to New Group. Name it by project or task type.

Writing rationales is the most time-consuming part of the job. You must explain your rating based on specific project guidelines. Avoid repetitive typing by using text expansion or dictation. Hold the fn key to dictate your rationale directly into the portal. Speak clearly and use punctuation commands like period or comma. This keeps your hands on the keyboard for navigation while you draft your thoughts.

If you are working with sensitive project data, always follow your employer's specific rules regarding data privacy and storage. Do not save proprietary guidelines to local cloud storage unless explicitly permitted by your contract.
blocks.title: Data Privacy

blocks.text: The role of AI assistants in evaluation

As an evaluator, your job is to judge output, not generate it. However, tools like Lazur can help you manage the environment. If you are stuck on a guideline, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to summarize the current page. It will read the screen content and provide a quick answer. This saves you from scrolling through long PDF documents or internal wikis.

Since you are an independent contractor, your time is your money. Many platforms do not pay for administrative time. This includes reading project updates or checking your email. Batch these tasks. Spend 15 minutes at the start of your shift to clear your inbox. Use Apple Reminders to track your billable hours. Create a list called Work Hours and add a new reminder for every block of time you spend in the portal.

items: Neglecting to clear your browser cache when the portal behaves poorly.
Working in a browser that is not updated to the latest version.
Failing to review guideline updates before starting a new batch.
Mixing up project requirements when working on multiple contracts.
Ignoring the time limit per task which can affect your quality score.

blocks.text: If your rating portal stops loading, clear your site data. In Chrome, go to Settings > Privacy and security > Third-party cookies. You can manage data for specific sites here. If you need to clear data for just the rating portal, use the lock icon in the address bar. Select Site settings, then click Clear data. This is often faster than clearing your entire browser history.
Structuring your day for maximum output

Consistency is key. Try to work at the same time each day. This helps your brain stay in the right frame for complex evaluation tasks. If you work 20 hours a week, split them into four-hour blocks. This prevents fatigue and keeps your quality ratings high. High-quality ratings lead to more task availability and better project assignments.

faq.question: Can I use AI to write my rationales?
faq.answer: You should check your project guidelines first. Most clients require rationales to be written by the human evaluator to ensure they accurately reflect your judgment process.

faq.question: What should I do if the portal keeps crashing?
faq.answer: First, try clearing your browser cache and cookies for that specific site. If that fails, update your browser or try a different one like Safari or Firefox. Always report persistent issues to your project manager.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside the rating portal?
faq.answer: Lazur works on your entire Mac screen. You can use it to read guidelines, draft text, or look up information while your portal is open in another window.
